scope: all deduplicated NatureBench runs present under runs_root

methodology.duration: sum of CLI Agent activation duration_ms; concurrent durations overlap
methodology.tokens: deduplicated native Claude CLI assistant usage records
methodology.usage_dedup: case + session + message id + model + exact usage tuple
methodology.cost: CLI-reported total_cost_usd from each wrapper stdout; this may be a canonical-model USD equivalent rather than the compatible backend's actual bill; missing values are not estimated
methodology.judge: Judge invocation count only; Judge token/cost is not present in current artifacts
methodology.calculated_cost: four token fields multiplied independently by the explicitly configured per-million-token prices; this does not overwrite CLI-reported cost
